title: Tehran,  October  26 - Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei, Head of the Iranian Judiciary, made remarks in a speech.
text:
Tehran,  October  26 - Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei, Head of the Iranian Judiciary, made remarks in a speech."

"------"

"SOT1, Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei, Iran's Judiciary Chief, (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:49): "This criminal America must have realized by now that the time for the greed, bullying, and imperial dominance they claimed over the world has passed. The days are gone when, through their own internal mercenaries and weak-willed individuals, they created so-called "protections" via decrees for their citizens to ensure that if someone committed even a single crime or offense in this country [Iran], no one could prosecute them. Today, America must have understood well that that era has passed.""

"SOT2, Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei, Iran's Judiciary Chief, (Farsi)-(00:50 - 01:33): "Today, our people have risen not only to seek vengeance for the recent martyrs and their martyred Imam, but they will also demand retribution for all of America's past crimes. God willing, it will soon be that in our own time, we see these criminals brought to the table of justice by the believers and with the grace of the Lord, and they will pay the price for all their crimes committed over various decades and past decades in Islamic Iran and in some other Islamic countries.
